g.text: Sliding window attention: the window, the ring buffer, and stacked reach
One layer, W = 4: token t attends to the previous W tokens
Ring buffer: entry for position i lives in slot i mod W
size never exceeds W; position t+1 overwrites slot (t+1) mod W
Stacked layers: after k layers, information can have moved up to k x W positions (theoretical)
theoretical reach: positions here can only be reached through several hops
where influence actually survives (PowerAttention passkey test)
